research_question: Can separate fixture-key message authentication and event-level witness matching quarantine a forged passive training corpus, and what happens under two-key collusion?
world: Existing third-rule NovelFeatureWorld, engineered public 2-dimensional features, unchanged synthetic dynamics.

corpus.actor: independent hash-seeded uniform public action choice

attack.falsification: Reuse exact external actor episodes. Rewrite up to 60 genuine harmful post-action public transitions as internally consistent productive outcomes, with fresh valid SHA replay.
attack.fixture_auth: Separate 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 keys for primary and witness in simulator harness. Public record binds full before, action, after, recomputed public outcome and witness role; verifier receives an explicit trusted keyring. No real PKI, external identity, consent or real provenance.
attack.gate: Exact episode-by-episode matching, known distinct roles and keys, valid MAC per record, full 240 paired events, no missing, repeated or out-of-order episodes. Reject/quarantine entire corpus if any problem. Exact match is necessary but not sufficient for truth.
attack.collusion: Both observer fixture keys sign identical fabricated public outcomes; this must PASS authentication and cross-source agreement despite being untrue, and its harmful test consequences must be reported.
provenance_limits: Valid MAC authenticates possession of supplied fixture key only, not honesty, sensor authenticity, independence, owner consent or harm-free action.
If both purported independent signers are dishonest or keys are compromised, coherent collusion may pass.
No learner-generated calibration probes; source actors can harm. Falsified dataset reuses events, don't double count actor harm.
The trusted verifier is provisioned out-of-band by harness, not by the observed records.
Test with no witness must abstain and count every task as incomplete.

frozen_controls: No changes to prior passive-quality protocol or historical benchmarks
No training on reserved test outcomes or future feature menus
Do not tune frozen policy based on reserved cohort; document all failures
No default learner promotion, outside actions or AthenZ/Synveil integration
